A.quote: If you turn on Elastic Load Balancing health checks, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can replace a running instance if any of the Elastic Load Balancing load balancers you attach to the Auto Scaling group report it as unhealthy.

B.quote: Each load balancer node routes requests only to the healthy targets in the enabled Availability Zones for the load balancer.

C.quote: You can send the health status of an instance directly to Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling by using the AWS CLI or an SDK.

D.quote: By default, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling ignores the results of the Elastic Load Balancing health checks.
